_comment: Canonical list of APM MetricSets (formerly 'indexed span tags') that must exist in the Splunk Observability Cloud tenant for this demo's Service Map breakdown, Tag Spotlight pivots, and a couple of detectors in terraform/observability.tf to function. Splunk does NOT currently expose a supported public REST API or Terraform resource for managing these; 05d-promote-metricsets.sh and docs/operations/metricsets.md are the two ways to get this list into the tenant. Keep both in sync with this file.

metricsets.why: Bronze / Silver / Gold cohort pivot (Tag Spotlight, Act II.B). Monitoring MTS feeds the [NatWest demo] Bronze tier decline rate detector.
Per-city p95 + RPS pivot (Tag Spotlight, ITSI Payments by Location). Monitoring MTS feeds the [NatWest demo] Madrid p95 latency detector.
Roaming pivots (Tag Spotlight; ITSI roaming KPIs).
FPS / BACS / CHAPS / SEPA / SWIFT / Cheque pivot. Monitoring MTS feeds the [NatWest demo] SWIFT error rate detector.
Cross-border / domestic split. Monitoring MTS feeds the roaming-payment p95 / error-rate KPIs in ITSI.
Mobile / online-banking / branch / bankline cohort (Act II.A.1).
Surfaces the regressed pairwise algorithm in Act I.2 / I.4.

Stable name attached to every recordPageAction span (mirrors the operation name) so RUM Tag Spotlight can group spans by user-action: Send payment, payment.completed, persona.switched, route.transition, payee.selected, validation.failed, cross_launch.clicked, chaos.action.requested, network.context, error.boundary.
Funnel-bottom dimension stamped on every payment.completed span (success / error / timeout). Monitoring MTS powers the SignalFlow conversion-rate-by-tier chart used in Act II.B.

Operator-side click marker on every chaos.action.requested span emitted from the /ops Chaos Dashboard. Pairs with the server-side nwpay:chaos audit event in ITSI so each inject/clear has both a browser-side and a controller-side trail.

Browser Network Information API value (4g / 3g / 2g / slow-2g / wifi). Lets the Madrid latency story cohort-split between fast-broadband Gold users and 3G Bronze users. Monitoring MTS feeds the SPA p95 by network type chart in the Payments Operations dashboard.
